known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.

The content simulation executes no break damage or gauge accumulation, so the staged break_intensity buff modifier has no live consumer yet. The modifier is granted as a real BuffManager buff through the wired gear::on_hit trigger path, but the buff-to-break-damage link is a Q1-V1 return condition, not a tested path.

crates/content/src/weapons/dustbin/projection.rs now reports "runtime_execution_validated": false (fixed in this audit per the batch-9 crowbar precedent): the BI modifier has no live break-damage consumer in the content simulation (Q1-V1 pending), so the projection must not claim validated execution. The grant/ICD/expiry path itself is executed and tested; only the downstream damage consumption is missing.

No native break-reduction trigger exists in the content simulation; the ntesim.trigger.break_reduction semantic tag is a content-owned scenario declaration (yaodao precedent), not asserted to be a native GameplayTag.
The 10s duration and 20s cooldown are read from buff_dustbin_CD / buff_dustbin_CD2 as seconds per the {1}s / {2}s description placeholders; no independent in-game timing evidence.
name: "Decomposer"

passive_description.localized: Increases wearer's Break Intensity by <lv>{0}</> for <lv>{1}</>s when reducing Break. Triggers at most once every <lv>{2}</>s.
passive_description.source: 装备者削减倾陷值时，自身提高<lv>{0}</>倾陷强度，持续<lv>{1}</>秒，<lv>{2}</>秒内最多触发一次。

tested_hypotheses: The ntesim.trigger.break_reduction semantic tag on the wearer packet is the trigger; untagged packets and missing packet metadata grant nothing. The tag is a content-owned scenario declaration (yaodao precedent); break reduction has no native trigger because the content simulation does not execute break damage or gauge accumulation. Return condition: when the engine models break reduction natively, replace the tag check with the native trigger.

The 20s internal cooldown is enforced per wearer by a cooldown marker buff (dustbin.break_cooldown); a trigger while the marker is active grants nothing, and a trigger at exactly the cooldown boundary grants a fresh buff.
The Break Intensity buff expires at the frozen 10s duration (BuffManager advance_time retires it).
The +60/+66/+72/+78/+84 point values, 10s duration and 20s cooldown are bound from CT_ForkBuff through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent=false unit checks.
The buff is wearer-only (BuffRecipient::SpecificActor) with no refresh (RefreshPolicy::Disallow, max_stacks 1).
